answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length lazy random walks on the attestation graph, with transition mass discounted across edges and capped by the walk horizon. A sybil cluster separated by a sparse external cut has low conductance, limiting incoming flow; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds therefore cap its aggregate voting weight despite internal amplification. Honest attestations provide the pigment, nectar, and wharf anchoring this resistance.
